notes.zh-CN: 新增网络代理设置：填写 http://127.0.0.1:7890 或 socks5://主机:端口，GrokX 启动的所有命令行（含 302.AI Media Studio）都使用该代理，保存后运行中的会话会重新连接，本机地址不走代理。排队消息发送前可编辑，并可在「排队」与「引导」（当前工具/思考结束后立即发送）间切换。手机端在网络恢复、回到前台或重连后自动恢复同步；会话同步携带所选模型与模型列表。macOS 为 universal，开发签名未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 为 debug 签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队已注册设备，均非商店包。
notes.en: New network proxy setting: enter http://127.0.0.1:7890 or socks5://host:port and every CLI GrokX starts (including 302.AI Media Studio) uses it; running sessions reconnect after saving, and local addresses stay direct. Queued messages can be edited before sending and switched between queued and steer mode (sent when the current tool/thinking finishes). The mobile app resumes sync automatically on network return, foreground, or reconnect; session sync now carries the selected model and its list. macOS is universal and development-signed, not notarized; Windows installers are unsigned; APK is debug-signed; IPA is development-signed for registered team devices only (none are store builds).
